```{r}
BAL_macrophages_small_1 <- subset(BAL_macrophages, downsample=150)

g <- FindMarkers(BAL_macrophages_small_1, ident.1 = "AM1", test.use = "t") %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>% mutate(gene=genifiy_2(ensg))

g %>%filter(avg_log2FC>0.5) %>%  arrange(p_val_adj)
g %>%filter(p_val_adj<0.05) %>%  arrange(-avg_log2FC)


dings_f <- function(x){
  x %>% ensemblizer_2() %>% VlnPlot(object = BAL_macrophages, features = .)+ggtitle(x)
}

"ABCC3" %>% dings_f()

c("CYP27A1","GCHFR","MARCO","GLRX","TREM2","CD9","FBP1", "TFRC", "TXN", "CCL18") %>% map(dings_f)



```

```{r cars}
BAL_macrophages$mono_am <- fct_collapse(BAL_macrophages$Cluster, group_mono = c("CD163LGMNM", "Monocytes",  "MonoM"), group_am=c("AM1","ProlifAM","AM2"))
markers_grouped_mon_am <- scran::findMarkers(
  x         = BAL_macrophages@assays$RNA@data,
  groups    = BAL_macrophages@meta.data$mono_am,
  pval.type = "some",
  test.type = "wilcox",
  direction = "up",
  block     = BAL_macrophages@meta.data$patient
)


markers_mono_am_tbl <- as.list(markers_grouped_mon_am) %>% 
  map(function(x)   as_tibble(x, rownames = "ensg")) %>% 
  purrr::reduce(bind_rows) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = AUC.group_mono:AUC.group_am, values_to = "AUC_", names_to = "clus") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(AUC_)) %>% 
  mutate(gene=genifiy_2(ensg)) %>% 
  relocate(gene) 


markers_grouped_mon_am <- markers_grouped_mon_am %>% as.list()

markers_grouped_mon_am[["group_mono"]] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>%
  mutate(gene=genifiy_2(ensg)) %>% arrange(FDR)

markers_grouped_mon_am[["group_mono"]] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>%
  mutate(gene=genifiy_2(ensg)) %>% arrange(-summary.AUC)

markers_grouped_mon_am[["group_am"]] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>%
  mutate(gene=genifiy_2(ensg)) %>% arrange(FDR)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
markers_cluster_tbl <- tibble()
for (clus in unique(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$Cluster)) {
  print(clus)
  groups_ <- fct_other(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$Cluster,keep = clus)
  
  dings<- scran::findMarkers(
  x         = BAL_macrophages@assays$RNA@data,
  groups    = groups_,
  pval.type = "some",
  test.type = "wilcox",
  direction = "up",
  block     = BAL_macrophages@meta.data$patient
)
  dings <- dings[[1]] %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>% mutate(clus=clus)

  markers_cluster_tbl <- markers_cluster_tbl %>% bind_rows(dings)
}


for (clus in unique(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$Cluster)) {

}
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
tf <- read_excel("DatabaseExtract_v_1.01.xlsx")
tf_genes <- tf %>% clean_names() %>%  filter(is_tf=="Yes") %>% pull(hgnc_symbol) %>% unique()
#matrix_mod<-BAL_macrophages_small_1@assays$RNA@data %>% as.matrix()
genes <- c("CD14","S100A8",  "APOC1", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DQA1", "C1QA", "LGMN", "CD163")
rele_genes <- c(tf_genes,genes) %>% ensemblizer_2()
rele_genes <- rele_genes[!is.na(rele_genes)]
matrix_mod<-BAL_macrophages@assays$RNA@data[ rownames(BAL_macrophages@assays$RNA@data) %in% rele_genes ,]  %>% as.matrix()
#matrix_mod <- matrix_mod[rowSums(matrix_mod)>5,]
rownames(matrix_mod) <- rownames(matrix_mod) %>% genifiy_2()
cor_list <- list()

for (gene_name in genes) {
  #gene_name <- "CSF1R"
  gene<-as.numeric(matrix_mod[gene_name,])
correlations<-apply(matrix_mod,1,function(x){cor(gene,x)})
correlations_tbl <- tibble(gene=names(correlations), cor=correlations, cor_gene=gene_name)

cor_list[[gene_name]] <- correlations_tbl
  
}

cor_tbl <- cor_list %>% purrr::reduce(bind_rows) #%>% %>% mutate(cor_gene=fct_reorder(cor_gene,.x = genes))

cor_tbl <- cor_list %>% purrr::reduce(bind_rows) %>%  mutate(cor_gene=fct_relevel(cor_gene,genes))
write_rds(cor_tbl,"cor_tbl.rds")

top_cor_genes <- cor_tbl %>% filter(gene %in% tf_genes) %>% group_by(cor_gene) %>% slice_max(cor,n=3) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()

cor_tbl <- cor_tbl%>%filter(gene%in%top_cor_genes)%>% group_by(cor_gene) %>% arrange(cor,.by_group = TRUE) %>% mutate(gene=fct_inorder(gene))
write_rds(cor_tbl,"cor_tbl.rds")



cor_hp <- cor_tbl %>%filter(gene%in%top_cor_genes) %>%
  group_by(cor_gene)%>% ungroup() %>% 
ggplot(aes(gene,cor_gene, fill=cor)) +geom_tile()+ theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90))+scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "RdBu"
  )
cor_hp
```
